influences.name: Kanye West
influences.context: Hopefully somewhere, someone along the way… hopefully Kanye.

influences.name: Cannonball Adderley
influences.context: My dad, whom I got my name from… when he died he was like 70 years old. I was always raised by a person who was much older. His values were from a different generation, and he would listen to a lot of jazz, like Cannonball Adderley.

influences.name: Rudy Ray Moore
influences.context: If you look up Rudy Ray Moore, he's an old comedian, really vulgar, based around story telling. So I'll come onto stage and I'll tell people and I tell them what I'm going to do before everything song, and where I was when I wrote the song.
